summary: Stage-A wave 2 complete: (1) H1 ANC parquets staged read-only from ERP1-TRACKA-COHORT-1 (AUDUSD 30,420 rows sha256 4e0ca174..., USDCAD 30,386 rows sha256 335a6e2a... — the USDCAD digest matches the ERP1-TRACKA-COHORT-2 PITDATA-pinned digest, cross-cycle provenance) with a data_freeze/H1_PANELS.json manifest and a DayPanel-compatible adapter (research/pc12a/h1_panels.py) behind the frozen run_dry engine (hour h at minute slot h*60+59, close stamped (h+1):00 PIT-honest, next-hour-open fills = the campaign H1 clock law, ask = bid + measured s_open, ANC left-boundary open semantics quantified and disclosed, volume = presence indicator). The 14 NOT_RUN-H1 legs floor-screened by exact-arm dry-run (no PnL): 9 FLOOR_PASS / 5 FLOOR_FAIL. (2) The campaign's FIRST PnL computation: Stage-A TRAIN diagnostics for all 62 floor-passed legs (46 wave-1 T1 + EURUSD-S009 T2 exemplar + 6 VOLPROF VC2/VC3 + 9 H1) as SOLO-leg engines on the frozen 8-fold expanding-TRAIN walk-forward (fold k window [2021-01-08, train_end_k], max 2025-06-20; test folds and the sealed 26w tail NEVER computed on; partition arithmetic + snapshot-vs-truncated prefix identity proven in tests). NET PnL per FILL_ACCOUNTING_SPEC (equity=cash+units*mid; residual asserted <=1e-6 on every fold, 0 violations across all 62x8). x2.0 cost stress per leg over the whole TRAIN span: 43 typed COST_DOMINATED kills (expectancy@x2.0 <= 0), 7 NO_ENTRIES_TRAIN. VOLPROF controls per class spec r2 section 7a/7c: CTRL-A dwell-matched random-entry + CTRL-C clock-only shadow, seeded single replicate per (arm, fold, ctrl) = 96 control rows; 0/96 cells have control >= arm (no clock/dwell null dominance observed on TRAIN; section 9 adjudication NOT performed here). COMPLEMENTARITY_TRAIN.json: per-fold pairwise weekly-equity-delta correlations + co-loss week counts for 1891 leg pairs at fold 7 (1485 computable corr, 232 weeks). Ledger: 711 wave-2 rows (496 MAIN + 62 X2 + 43 kills + 96 controls + 14 floor) appended; ledger total 796 of the 1500 cap (stop line 1400 respected). Negative expectancy recorded plainly as expected (40/62 legs negative NET on the fold-7 TRAIN window; no tuning, no rescue).

runtime.disclosure: compute exceeded the ~45-min guidance; split as parallel per-symbol passes (EUR / GBPUSD-A / GBPUSD-B / JPY / H1) inside one locked job per tier, per the dispatch's split-and-disclose law; two honest restarts happened (governance import path; H1 two-symbol file collision) and one coverage gap fix (the GBPUSD split glob initially dropped the 2 VC arms - MAIN grid for them re-run as a GBPVC group; no partial output was ever committed or ledgered); per-pass wall times in diagnostics/ORCHESTRATOR_LOG.txt and DIAG_MANIFEST.json

honesty_notes: Negative expectancy is the expected outcome (much of the 62 carries FAMILY_HISTORY_NEGATIVE history); rows record it plainly - no tuning, no rescue, no post-hoc relaxation.

Solo-engine E1 disclosure: the frozen E1 floor arms 26w after the ENGINE's first decision. In the multi-leg dry-run that stamps every leg at the symbol's fastest decider (several H1 legs deadlock to 0 fills there); in solo diagnostics it arms 26w after the LEG's own first decision. Both are frozen-engine behaviors; solo is the diagnostic semantic; both disclosed in ledger floor rows and run_diag.py.

H1 ANC open semantics: bar opens are left-boundary quotes (open > high on 2,504/2,566 of ~30.4k hours; never below low); the adapter enforces close-in-[low,high] + non-negative spread and consumes opens only as boundary fill quotes (quantified in h1_panels.py + H1_PANELS.json).

Cost cells for H1 pairs: C1 per the wave-2 dispatch COST_AUTHORITY_TABLE note (USDCAD 1.2/1.6, AUDUSD 1.0/1.3 pips - governing); census overall_open p90 1.7/1.4 disclosed alongside in H1_PANELS.json; C2/C3 from the ERP1 census session buckets. W4 price domains extended with the ERP1 registered bands (without this every H1 fill was W4-killed - caught by the wave's own smoke).

Controls are single seeded replicates per (arm, fold, ctrl) - the class-spec kill conditions (CTRL-A/CTRL-C/CTRL-B2 ensembles) are NOT adjudicated in wave 2; the control rows record control_ge_arm comparisons only (0/96 control>=arm).
The 9 pre-wave-2 floor-fail legs (6 M1 T1 + 3 VC1) and the 5 H1 floor fails were not diagnosed (pre-PnL kills per wave-1 law; floor failures are permanent FLAP rows, no post-hoc relaxation).

x2 rows carry tier=2.0 + stress_tier markers; a COST_DOMINATED kill means full-TRAIN expectancy at x2.0 <= 0 exactly per campaign section 4; NO_ENTRIES_TRAIN is an honest empty book (solo E1 or no signals), NOT cost domination.

All diagnostics artifacts carry label DISCOVERY-TRAIN-ONLY; every train_window in the ledger ends <= 2025-06-20; test folds 2022-01-07..2025-12-26 and the sealed tail 2026-01-02..2026-06-26 untouched (partition proven by tests/test_pc12a_stageA_wave2.py).
